shared_changes.fix: For the Family-wise error rate topic at approximately lines 601–604, replace 'with thousands of tests it leaves almost no power' and the unqualified 'It is stricter than the false discovery rate' with a precise description: FWER controls the chance of any false rejection, while FDR controls an expected false-discovery proportion; Bonferroni can lose power in large families, depending on effect sizes, dependence, and design. Preserve links, exact definition, and supported methods.
